name: teamcall
description: Move a company's people from the chat window to a terminal agent in 30 days, and measure it: a pilot charter from 5 people to 30-50 with a one-page set-up for IT, a 20-minute fast path per person, a 5-hour champion path, the same task turned into one command (termboost), a transition journal, a report on six measurements (time, quality, coverage, repeatability, new capability, what a person checks) with the minutes of human help per first working result, a scale-or-stop page, and which seat already pays for which terminal agent. It counts and plans; it buys nothing.
